WITH policies AS ( SELECT policy.*, definition.workflow_code, definition.timezone FROM batch.workflow_monitoring_policy policy JOIN batch.workflow_definition definition ON definition.tenant_id = policy.tenant_id AND definition.id = policy.workflow_definition_id WHERE policy.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ), opportunities AS ( SELECT policy.*, occurrence.id AS occurrence_id, occurrence.biz_date, occurrence.scheduled_fire_time AS expected_at, 'scheduled_occurrence:' || occurrence.id AS resource_key, occurrence.request_id, CASE WHEN occurrence.occurrence_status NOT IN ('PLANNED', 'REQUESTED', 'WAITING_READINESS', 'MISFIRE_PENDING') THEN occurrence.updated_at END AS opportunity_closed_at FROM policies policy JOIN batch.scheduled_occurrence occurrence ON occurrence.tenant_id = policy.tenant_id AND occurrence.workflow_definition_id = policy.workflow_definition_id UNION ALL SELECT policy.*, occurrence.id AS occurrence_id, occurrence.biz_date, COALESCE(occurrence.due_at, occurrence.expected_at) AS expected_at, 'expected_work_occurrence:' || occurrence.id AS resource_key, occurrence.trigger_request_id AS request_id, CASE WHEN occurrence.occurrence_status IN ('CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED') THEN occurrence.updated_at END AS opportunity_closed_at FROM policies policy JOIN batch.expected_work_occurrence occurrence ON occurrence.tenant_id = policy.tenant_id AND occurrence.workflow_definition_id = policy.workflow_definition_id ), observed AS ( SELECT opportunity.*, run.id AS workflow_run_id, COALESCE(run.trace_id, request.trace_id) AS trace_id, run.started_at, run.finished_at, CASE WHEN run.id IS NULL THEN opportunity.opportunity_closed_at END AS closed_without_run_at, opportunity.expected_at + opportunity.start_grace_seconds * INTERVAL '1 second' AS start_deadline, ((opportunity.expected_at AT TIME ZONE opportunity.timezone)::date + opportunity.completion_deadline_day_offset + opportunity.completion_deadline_local_time) AT TIME ZONE opportunity.timezone AS completion_deadline FROM opportunities opportunity LEFT JOIN batch.trigger_request request ON request.tenant_id = opportunity.tenant_id AND request.request_id = opportunity.request_id AND request.workflow_definition_id = opportunity.workflow_definition_id AND request.parent_workflow_run_id IS NULL
LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT run.id, run.trace_id, run.started_at, run.finished_at, run.dry_run FROM batch.workflow_run run WHERE run.tenant_id = request.tenant_id AND run.trigger_request_id = request.id AND run.workflow_definition_id = opportunity.workflow_definition_id UNION ALL SELECT run.id, run.trace_id, run.started_at, run.finished_at, run.dry_run FROM archive.workflow_run_archive run WHERE run.tenant_id = request.tenant_id AND run.trigger_request_id = request.id AND run.workflow_definition_id = opportunity.workflow_definition_id AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM batch.workflow_run hot WHERE hot.tenant_id = request.tenant_id AND hot.trigger_request_id = request.id AND hot.workflow_definition_id = opportunity.workflow_definition_id) ) run ON true WHERE opportunity.expected_at IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(run.dry_run, false) = false AND COALESCE(request.dry_run, false) = false ), candidates AS ( SELECT tenant_id, workflow_definition_id, workflow_code, workflow_run_id, occurrence_id, biz_date, trace_id, resource_key, expected_at, started_at, finished_at, closed_without_run_at AS opportunity_closed_at, start_deadline AS monitoring_deadline_at, start_grace_severity AS severity, 'NOT_STARTED' AS violation, 'WORKFLOW_NOT_STARTED_BY_DEADLINE' AS alert_type FROM observed WHERE start_grace_seconds > 0 AND start_deadline < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND COALESCE(started_at, finished_at, closed_without_run_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) > start_deadline AND COALESCE(started_at, finished_at, closed_without_run_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) >= policy_effective_at UNION ALL SELECT tenant_id, workflow_definition_id, workflow_code, workflow_run_id, occurrence_id, biz_date, trace_id, resource_key, expected_at, started_at, finished_at, closed_without_run_at, completion_deadline, completion_deadline_severity, 'NOT_COMPLETED_BY_DEADLINE', 'WORKFLOW_NOT_COMPLETED_BY_DEADLINE' FROM observed WHERE completion_deadline_local_time IS NOT NULL AND completion_deadline < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND COALESCE(finished_at, closed_without_run_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) > completion_deadline AND COALESCE(finished_at, closed_without_run_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) >= policy_effective_at UNION ALL SELECT run.tenant_id, run.workflow_definition_id, policy.workflow_code, run.id, NULL::bigint, run.biz_date, run.trace_id, 'workflow_run:' || run.id, NULL::timestamptz, run.started_at, run.finished_at, NULL::timestamptz, run.started_at + policy.soft_runtime_seconds * INTERVAL '1 second', policy.soft_runtime_severity, 'RUNNING_TOO_LONG', 'WORKFLOW_RUNNING_TOO_LONG' FROM batch.workflow_run run JOIN policies policy ON policy.tenant_id = run.tenant_id AND policy.workflow_definition_id = run.workflow_definition_id WHERE run.dry_run = false AND run.started_at IS NOT NULL AND policy.soft_runtime_seconds > 0 AND COALESCE(run.finished_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) > run.started_at + policy.soft_runtime_seconds * INTERVAL '1 second' AND COALESCE(run.finished_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) >= policy.policy_effective_at ) SELECT candidate.* FROM candidates candidate WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM batch.alert_event alert WHERE alert.tenant_id = candidate.tenant_id AND alert.alert_type = candidate.alert_type AND alert.detail_json ->> 'monitoringResourceKey' = candidate.resource_key ) AND candidate.resource_key = #{resourceKey} AND candidate.violation = #{violation} ORDER BY candidate.monitoring_deadline_at, candidate.resource_key, candidate.violation LIMIT #{limit}
